message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzzer/flatbuffers_scalar_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":205,"var":"data[2..size)","code":"const std::string original(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(data), size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes after the two-byte prefix are copied into a C++ string, preserving the raw scalar text candidate."},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzzer/flatbuffers_scalar_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":206,"var":"input","code":"auto input = std::string(original.c_str());","note":"The input is truncated at the first NUL and becomes the exact JSON scalar text that the fuzzer will feed into the parser."},
  {"step":3,"file":"tests/fuzzer/flatbuffers_scalar_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":219,"var":"schema","code":"auto schema = \"table X { Y: \" + std::string(ref_res.type) + \"; } root_type X;\";","note":"The first flag byte selects the scalar type, so the parser is configured to interpret the attacker string as that scalar kind."},
  {"step":4,"file":"tests/fuzzer/flatbuffers_scalar_fuzzer.cc","function":"Parse","line":214,"var":"json","code":"auto done = parser.ParseJson(json.c_str());","note":"The crafted JSON object \"{\\\"Y\\\" : \" + input + \"}\" is parsed, propagating the attacker-controlled scalar text into FlatBuffers' JSON parser."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/idl_parser.cpp","function":"Parser::ParseAnyValue","line":1060,"var":"val.type.base_type","code":"switch (val.type.base_type) {","note":"The parser dispatches the attacker-controlled token to the scalar conversion path for the selected field type."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/idl_parser.cpp","function":"Parser::ParseSingleValue","line":null,"var":"field_value.constant","code":"ParseSingleValue(field ? &field->name : nullptr, val, false)","note":"The scalar text is converted into a stored constant string that later becomes the serialized field value."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/idl_parser.cpp","function":"Parser::ParseTable","line":1304,"var":"val / valdef","code":"ECHECK(atot(field_value.constant.c_str(), *this, &val));","note":"The stored scalar text is converted again while building the buffer, so any malformed or edge-case numeric text reaches the scalar conversion sink."},
  {"step":8,"file":"include/flatbuffers/flatbuffers.h","function":"FlatBufferBuilder::AddElement","line":1456,"var":"e","code":"if (IsTheSameAs(e, def) && !force_defaults_) return;","note":"Because the fuzzer enables force_defaults, the builder writes scalar bytes even when they equal the default, increasing the chance that an uninitialized scalar field is later observed."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/idl_gen_text.cpp","function":"GenStruct","line":295,"var":"output_anyway","code":"auto output_anyway = (opts.output_default_scalars_in_json || fd.key) && IsScalar(fd.value.type.base_type) && !fd.deprecated;","note":"When the parsed value is printed back, scalar fields are emitted even when default-valued, ensuring the sink reads the stored scalar from the buffer."},
  {"step":10,"file":"include/flatbuffers/base.h","function":"ReadScalar","line":406,"var":"*reinterpret_cast<const T *>(p)","code":"return EndianScalar(*reinterpret_cast<const T *>(p));","note":"The sink performs a typed load from the buffer; if the parser left any scalar bytes uninitialized, this read triggers the MSan use-of-uninitialized-value."}
]
JSON
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/flatbuffers/tests/fuzzer/flatbuffers_scalar_fuzzer.cc /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true
